description: This file defines the DocModel class, which encapsulates documentation strings for an AWS service and provides methods to retrieve documentation for services, operations, errors, and shapes within a specific AWS SDK version context.

classes.name: Aws\Api\DocModel
classes.description: A class that manages documentation strings for an AWS service-version, providing methods to access specific documentation details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DocModel with a documentation array; requires the 'tidy' PHP extension.

methods.name: getServiceDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation string for the entire service.

methods.name: getOperationDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific operation given its name.

methods.name: getErrorDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific error given its name.

methods.name: getShapeDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a shape within a context, considering references, base docs, appends, and exclusions.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans and formats documentation content using the PHP tidy extension.
